verdict.rationale: The official bugsnag-js SDK automatically detects errors in the browser, Node.js and React Native. It has framework plugins for React, Vue, Angular, Express, Restify and Koa, which covers web frontend, backend and mobile. Docs cite libraries for over 50 platforms and native iOS/Android/Flutter SDKs, and a hands-on user confirms the iOS SDK auto-reports fatal errors within minutes of setup. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic uncaught-error capture for backend languages beyond Node.js, and recent independent hands-on corroboration across platforms.
